organic_growth.rate_effect_note: INFERENCE: P&C rates had begun rising (early hard market, from late 2018); release gives no rate split. Underlying measured vs 2018 incl. JLT, so acquisition column not shown (reported +11% largely JLT, closed Apr-2019). Marsh 4%, Guy Carpenter 5%, Consulting 3%.
INFERENCE: hard-market rate increases supported RIS (+3% underlying; Marsh 3%, GC 6%) while Consulting fell -2% (COVID). Rate share not quantified by management.
INFERENCE: peak hard market (Marsh index double-digit rate increases) plus strong new business; Marsh 11%, GC 9%, Consulting 10%. Not split by management.
INFERENCE: continued (decelerating) rate increases plus inflation-driven exposure growth; Marsh 8%, GC 9%, Consulting 8%.

Management (calls 2023): growth from rate increases (Marsh Global Insurance Market Index +2% to +4% per quarter; property +6-10%), exposure/inflation, double-digit new business in US & Canada and high retention. INFERENCE: rate contribution ~1-3pts.

Management Q2-24: '26 quarters of rate increases which just turned flat now'. INFERENCE: rate contribution fell to ~0-1pt by H2-24; growth mainly new business/retention/exposure. Marsh 7%, GC 8%, Consulting 6%.

10-K MD&A: RIS growth 'partially offset by declining insurance and reinsurance premium rates'; Marsh index -4% in Q4-25 (property -9%). INFERENCE: rates a ~0 to -1pt drag. FX 0.4 is derived ($104m) not stated. Acq 6% mainly McGriff (closed Nov-2024). Marsh Risk 4%, GC 5%, Consulting 5%.

latest_interim.note: Q3-26: underlying 5% (GAAP 8%, acq 3%, FX 0). 9M: RIS 3% (Risk/Marsh 4%, Reinsurance -1%), Consulting 7%. Q3: Risk 5% (US/Canada 4%, International 6%), Reinsurance -6%, Consulting 8%. Marsh index Q1-26 -5%, Q2-26 -6% (property -12%).

geography.note: 10-K: 'approximately 51% of 2025 total revenue' from outside the U.S. -> US ~49% (derived). Marsh Risk only: US/Canada $8,523m vs International $5,843m (59%/41%). UK/Europe/China splits not extracted (Item 8 note not read). China immaterial (INFERENCE).
